text.tspan: Aviation's share of global CO₂ emissions 1940 to 2021
Given as a share of carbon dioxide emissions from fossil fuels and land use change.

tspan.tspan: Calculated by Our World in Data based on Lee et al. (2020); Bergero et al. (2023); and the Global Carbon Project.
Non-CO₂ forcings from aviation, and the increased warming impacts are altitude are not included.
